sets.name: Camp Kit
sets.identity: Four commons any army has lying about.
sets.special_text: After a day without a battle the hero starts the next day with +3 map movement.

sets.name: Ferryman's Fare
sets.identity: Two coins for the ferryman and a pair of sea boots.
sets.special_text: Boarding and leaving a ship costs no movement.

sets.name: Night Watch
sets.identity: A watchman's coat, lantern and boots.
sets.special_text: All unused movement is kept for the next day.
